title: Quest log
summary: DMs can write quests and choose who knows about them; players follow them in their own quest log.
items: DMs: Quests lets you write quests with a giver, a place, objectives, a promised reward and private DM notes, then reveal them to the whole party or chosen characters.
Hidden objectives, DM notes and DM-only chronicle lines never reach players' devices.
Mark objectives done or failed, add chronicle entries stamped with the session and campaign day, and close quests as completed or failed.
Rewards are words plus links to receipts you already paid; writing or closing a quest never moves coins or items.
Players: Home → Quest log shows Active, Done and Failed quests, a Follow pin with Show on map, private notes and a Quest updated notice.
Quests also appear on the DM's Desk, on NPC cards and in the map's Here sheet as Quests here.
